author: StefaniaHergane
title: LLM accuracy GPU tests fail with HuggingFace 429 Too Many Requests
signature: httpx HTTPStatusError Client error 429 Too Many Requests for url huggingface.co api models tree|External Service

failed_jobs.name: LLM accuracy iGPU tests / LLM accuracy GPU tests
failed_jobs.symptom: httpx.HTTPStatusError: 429 Too Many Requests from huggingface.co

key_errors: httpx.HTTPStatusError: Client error '429 Too Many Requests' for url 'https://huggingface.co/api/models/Qwen/Qwen2-0.5B-Instruct/tree/...'
root_cause: The Hugging Face API rate-limited the CI runner with HTTP 429, preventing the test fixture from downloading model metadata for Qwen/Qwen2-0.5B-Instruct. This is a transient external service limitation unrelated to the PR changes (which only touched NPU functional tests). The rate limit is triggered when too many CI jobs concurrently query the HF API.
reproduction_steps: N/A — rate limiting is environment-specific and non-deterministic.
recommended_actions: Re-run the failed jobs once the rate limit window passes.
Add HF token authentication to the test environment for higher rate limits.
Add retry logic with exponential backoff for HuggingFace API calls in test fixtures.
prevention_strategies: Authenticate with a HuggingFace token to raise rate limits. Add retry/backoff logic in model download steps to handle 429 responses gracefully.
historical_context: No prior occurrences of this specific HuggingFace 429 pattern found in the investigation database.
